title: Filling Diamonds
statementMd:
You have integer $n$. Calculate how many ways are there to fully cover belt-like area of $4n-2$ triangles with diamond shapes.

Diamond shape consists of two triangles. You can move, rotate or flip the shape, but you cannot scale it.

$2$ coverings are different if some $2$ triangles are covered by the same diamond shape in one of them and by different diamond shapes in the other one.

Please look at pictures below for better understanding.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e0fea29aefdb21f54a0a87c19e1b6fa0aa7eefe7.png) On the left you can see the diamond shape you will use, and on the right you can see the area you want to fill.![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4a52d4205ad7630ef6dbd057d6c3fca8a820efa4.png) These are the figures of the area you want to fill for $n = 1, 2, 3, 4$.

You have to answer $t$ independent test cases.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^{4}$) — the number of test cases.

Each of the next $t$ lines contains a single integer $n$ ($1 \le n \le 10^{9}$).

## Output

For each test case, print the number of ways to fully cover belt-like area of $4n-2$ triangles using diamond shape. It can be shown that under given constraints this number of ways doesn't exceed $10^{18}$.

## Note

In the first test case, there are the following $2$ ways to fill the area:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b172e94e9fd7027c24f4ebe2b9efecd6bb9837eb.png)

In the second test case, there is a unique way to fill the area:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/540274c0723cb2c7a676bc5c963da672e107b608.png)
statementZhMd:
你有一个整数 $n$。请计算用菱形完全覆盖由 $4n-2$ 个三角形组成的带状区域的方法数。

菱形由两个三角形组成。你可以移动、旋转或翻转这个图形，但不能对其进行缩放。

如果存在两个三角形，在一种覆盖方案中它们被同一个菱形覆盖，而在另一种覆盖方案中它们被不同的菱形覆盖，则认为这 $2$ 种覆盖方案不同。

请查看下面的图片以便更好地理解题意。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e0fea29aefdb21f54a0a87c19e1b6fa0aa7eefe7.png) 左侧是你要使用的菱形，右侧是你需要填充的区域。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4a52d4205ad7630ef6dbd057d6c3fca8a820efa4.png) 这些是 $n = 1, 2, 3, 4$ 时需要填充的区域图形。

你需要回答 $t$ 个相互独立的测试用例。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^{4}$）——测试用例的数量。

接下来的 $t$ 行中，每行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出使用菱形完全覆盖由 $4n-2$ 个三角形组成的带状区域的方法数。可以证明，在给定约束下，该方法数不会超过 $10^{18}$。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b172e94e9fd7027c24f4ebe2b9efecd6bb9837eb.png)

在第二个测试用例中，只有唯一一种填充方法：
